baselineExplanation: The task began after a pre-existing main merge. The two rendering functions were identical to f57cc0d. Flower3d/tree.js merge changes are preserved against c06bdde; GLB, blend and generator match both commits.

sourceScope.notes: Outside-function comparisons preserve the merged camera/layout, loading, interactions, flower/tree logic and UI. AST comparison excludes location/comment metadata; exact text comparison also passes.

shaderReview.status: No current-version compatibility, opacity or scope defect found. Circular tint remains continuous; the added upper specular response is mathematically bounded.

weights.reflectionInvariant: The existing inverse-view direction helper normalizes the reflected direction.
weights.proof: For unit reflection, each horizontal dot is bounded by one; 0.8660254^2+0.5^2 is slightly below one. Terms cancel in the sum. Weights are continuous polynomial expressions with no azimuth wrap or angular thresholds.

conservativeRgbMultiplierBounds.note: Final indirect-specular bounds include the [1,32] upper-response gain. These are conservative independent-factor envelopes, not measured output pixel values.

shaderReview.runtimeNativeIridescenceZero: Pre-existing runtime choice retained; GLB native iridescence remains byte-identical.
shaderReview.scope: Only the shared ground/basin material receives the guarded hook. Previous compile callback and custom cache-key isolation are preserved.
shaderReview.portability: The angular tint is runtime JavaScript/GLSL; it is not written into the GLB. Existing standalone PBR fallback is unchanged.
shaderReview.continuityLimit: Shader continuity follows analytically. Perceived all-angle sheen, environment seams, clipping and orbit stability are assessed in browser visual QA.

upperSpecularResponse.proof: Each cardinal-upper direction has unit length. For unit reflected r, all dot products are <=1. The scalar expression is the nonnegative maximum of those four dots. Raising a nonnegative maximum to power12 is exactly the maximum of the four nonnegative power12 lobes.
upperSpecularResponse.continuity: The value is continuous around the full orbit. Max/abs switches can have derivative kinks at equal-cardinal directions, but no value jumps or angular wrap.
upperSpecularResponse.appearance: Selected to provide a soft upper sheen, not a sharp mirror glint. Perceived softness and highlight clipping remain visual QA criteria.
upperSpecularResponse.scope: Multiplies existing indirect specular only; diffuse illumination, direct lighting, clearcoat, opacity and emission are unchanged by this upper-response block.

complexity.interpretation: Relative to baseline, two smoothsteps become one and four mixes become two. Fifth-power grazing becomes a square; circular tint adds simple multiply/add arithmetic. The new upper lobe uses four multiplies for power12 plus affine/final-gain arithmetic, 2 abs and 2 max. No extra trigonometry, pow calls, texture fetches, per-frame JavaScript callbacks, draws or fullscreen passes are introduced. Source operation counts are not GPU instructions or timing measurements.

environmentCapture.additionalStartupCost: Five extra temporary cards increase one-time PMREM scene capture work. They are disposed after capture; they add no per-frame island geometry or runtime draws.

coverageRevision.notes: The four broadened 12 x 3.8 cards and all nine horizon cards remain selected; no canopy cards are present. This was the earlier coverage-only revision. The final shader additionally contains the bounded upper specular response described above.

complexity.performanceLimit: Final frame-time and actual render-call measurements are recorded separately by browser QA; no physical mobile GPU performance claim is made here.

verification.shaderHelperCompatibility: Current Three.js physical shader exposes aomap_fragment, geometryNormal, geometryViewDir and transformDirectionByInverseViewMatrix in the expected order.
